title: Order
description: Represents a trading order in the Kickama exchange matching engine. Derived from the Go struct defined in market/types/types.go.

type.description: Order type: 0 = limit, 1 = market, 2 = stop_limit, 3 = stop_market, 4 = trailing_stop, 5 = iceberg

status.description: Order status: 0 = new, 1 = partially_filled, 2 = filled, 3 = cancelled, 4 = rejected, 5 = expired

price.description: Order price as a decimal string

stop_price.description: Stop price for stop orders, as a decimal string

quantity.description: Order quantity as a decimal string

filled_quantity.description: Quantity that has been filled, as a decimal string

remaining_quantity.description: Quantity remaining to be filled, as a decimal string

leaves_quantity.description: Leaves quantity (qty still working on the book), as a decimal string

cumulative_quote_quantity.description: Cumulative quote quantity traded, as a decimal string

avg_price.description: Average fill price, as a decimal string

time_in_force.description: Time-in-force policy: 0 = GTC (good till cancelled), 1 = IOC (immediate or cancel), 2 = FOK (fill or kill), 3 = GTD (good till date)

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the order was created

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the order was last updated

expire_at.description: Optional expiry timestamp for GTD orders (RFC 3339)

iceberg_quantity.description: Total iceberg order quantity, as a decimal string (only for iceberg orders)

display_quantity.description: Visible display quantity on the book for iceberg orders, as a decimal string
